name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd
title: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd - 543573 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue Rs1,477 cr (+56% YoY) and FY26 operating EBITDA Rs545 cr at 11.3%, but FY27 margin guided down to 10.5–11% and PCB capex of ~Rs800 cr adds a supply-side build-out.

utilisation.quote: The utilization of our people resources, utilization of our machines have gone up significantly over FY '25.

capex.quote: we are expecting INR100 crores to INR150 crores of capex investment into the current year, which is FY '27.

triggers.label: PCB capex ~Rs800 cr multi-year
triggers.quote: we are planning to spend approximately $90 million, which is INR800 crores of capex over the year

triggers.label: FY27 margin guided 10.5–11% vs 12% delivered
triggers.quote: next year, we are guiding 10.5% to 11%, keeping this turmoil into account

triggers.label: Working capital days 69 → 63
triggers.quote: our working capital days improved from 69 days to 63 days on a year-on-year basis

triggers.label: Pass-through exists but lagged
triggers.quote: we have contract arrangements with the customers where there is a pass-through mechanism of variation in prices. Now does it happen on day 0? The answer is no.

triggers.label: Competitive intensity to rise
triggers.quote: Competition -- competitive intensity would increase. Am I afraid of it? No. Am I mindful of it? Yes.

guidance.quote: We remain committed to our aspirations of sustained revenue growth of 35%
next year, we are guiding 10.5% to 11%, keeping this turmoil into account
targeting INR700 crores of total EBITDA for the next year, FY '27
we are targeting INR1,500 crores plus
Consumer, we are cautiously pegging it down at about 30% of our revenue.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have achieved EBITDA of INR545 crores
we generated a healthy operating cash flow of INR290 crores
we have brought it down from 69 days to 63 days

red_flags.label: Net cash falls sharply against PCB capex plan
red_flags.quote: we will be short of cash in terms of -- if we assume another INR200 crores, INR300 crores

red_flags.label: Order book growth slowed Dec–Mar
red_flags.quote: Between December and March, our order book has grown by almost 3% versus our historical run rate of 7% to 10%.

evasions.quote: this order book is indicating whatever is there in hand today
So we would like to have the luxury of being conservative.
